q.g: In this quest you first have to find the torture room inside The Labyrinth. Afterwards you have to obtain evidence of the torture in form of a videotape. There are multiple spawn locations near the room.

sh.c: Torture room location marked on map
Spawn 2: In the wall opposite the room
Spawn 3: In the hand of a dead Scav on the ground under the arch opposite the roomNote: The body doesn't always spawn, but the tape can still be there
Spawn 4: On top of bloody barrels adjacent to the arch opposite the room
